summary: Database migration caused a production outage because a field was removed before all application instances were updated.
lesson: Use backward-compatible database migrations and deploy schema changes before application changes.

summary: Order processing failed because a required environment variable was missing during a payment configuration deployment.
lesson: Verify all required production environment variables before deployment.

summary: CI tests became flaky because test runs shared a database without proper cleanup.
lesson: Use isolated test environments and clean database state between test runs.

summary: A dependency upgrade was successfully deployed using automated tests, canary deployment, monitoring, and a rollback plan.
lesson: Use staged deployment, monitoring, automated tests, and rollback preparation for dependency upgrades.
